# opnsense_monit_alert (Data Source)

Monit alert recipients (**Services ▸ Monit ▸ Settings ▸ Alert Settings**).

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the Monit alert.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this alert is enabled.
- `events` (Set of String) Events that trigger (or, with `not_on`, do not trigger) an alert. Empty means all events.
- `format` (String) Custom mail format, see the Monit documentation.
- `not_on` (Boolean) When enabled, `events` lists the events that do **not** trigger an alert.
- `recipient` (String) Email address that receives the alerts.
- `reminder` (Number) Send a reminder every this many cycles while the error persists.
